name: The Legend of Zelda: Temple of Seasons
summary: This is a five-dungeon hack featuring Link’s adventures through a fully developed Temple of Seasons. From the depths of Subrosia to the peak of Mount Tetra, our hero must navigate all manner of threats without the help of his trusty sword! Here more than ever, your growing arsenal is necessary for both traversal and combat, and expect a few brand-new items to add a fresh take on navigation even for Oracles veterans.
